notes.title: Important message about Space Run Galaxy
notes.content:
Hello, Space Runners,

A few weeks ago, we were the target of a cyber attack on the Space Run Galaxy online servers. The hacker(s) took advantage of a vulnerability that has now been corrected, but which allowed the intruders to access and delete the database and its back-ups.

The servers were temporarily offline for a short time. Thank you for your alerts, which enabled us to bring the servers back online and fix this vulnerability. 

Unfortunately, this situation resulted in the complete loss of your game progress. We know how important your Space Run Galaxy experience is, so we'll be putting in place a process that will allow you to recover a custom game save, ensuring you don't have to start a new game from scratch.

We're very sorry about this situation, and we hope that the solution provided by Passtech Games and Focus Entertainment will work for you.

Please be reassured that these hackers have not recovered any personal data about your account, as we do not store such information on our servers at all.

[b]Contact us at this e-mail address to recover a custom game save of Space Run Galaxy:[/b]
support@passtechgames.com

- Passtech Games & Focus Entertainment

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/30/1469524129-srg-kraken-1.gif[/img]

Hello Space Runners, 

[b]We're pleased to release a fifth update for Space Run Galaxy![/b]

Your feedback have been really helpful so far. Please keep them coming on this new version! 

Here is the patch log for the version 1.0.5: 

[h1][b]Global Balance[/b][/h1]

In order to smooth the overall progression, we adjusted some rewards and restrictions in the game. This should lead to an overall less grindy and more pleasant experience, especially at the beginning of the game.

[list][*]Story missions now always offer an additional Space Credits bonus to their rewards. Space Credits are very versatile and can help to buy some missing resources, or new ships.
[*]Some mechanics now have more categories available, especially the basic one (Yellow). Because they require multiple types of resources, yellow modules are already difficult to craft and extra cells are often critical to get. This should help to craft these modules more frequently, especially when combined whith the first balance point.[/list]

[h1][b]Client[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Fix of black screen bugs on Radeon and Intel HD graphic cards.
[*]Added an option to switch between push & toggle for in-game zoom in & out.
[*]Improved sound management to avoid too many being played at a time.
[*]Fix of a bug that could make the ship disappear after landing on a station.
[*]Fixed a bug on plasma cannon that could lead to a non constructible space on ship
[*]Fix of a bug that could lead to weapons aiming at unreachable targets.[/list]

[h1][b]Servers[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Various optimizations[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/26/1467300336-srg-planets-1.gif[/img]

Hey Space Runners,

[b]We're pleased to release a third update for Space Run Galaxy![/b]

Your feedback have been really helpful so far. Please keep them coming on this new version! 

Here is the patch log for the version 1.0.3: 

[h1][b]Servers[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Fixed a compatibility bug from v1.0.1 to v1.0.2 that could lead to missions ending with more cargo than intended.
[*]Various performance optimizations.[/list]

[h1][b]Client[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Various network performance improvements.
[*]Some loadings & video memory optimizations.
[*]Fixed in-game User Interface to fit 5/4 resolutions.
[*]Fixed 'Gotta Craft'em all' achievement & badge (retroactive)
[*]Fixed the 'create sale' button in the merchant section that could lead to an invalid network request when published sales list is already full.
[*]Fixed modules with a switch ability that could lead to invalid occupation behaviors or construction removal by PSY cargo.
[*]Fixed a bug that could lead to have 0 Thurst when restarting a run after being destroyed by a boss.
[*]On delivery rewards, you can now click the 'Thank you!' button even if some random rewards are unpacked to collect them all.[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hey Space Runners,

We're pleased to release a second update for Space Run Galaxy!

Your feedback have been really helpful so far. Please keep them coming on this new version!

Here is the patch log:

[h1]Servers[/h1]
[list][*]Many performance improvements.[/list]
[h1]Client[/h1]
[list][*]Various network requests improvements.
[*]Crash fix : first mission of the game can no longer be abandoned (which lead to a corrupted profile).
[*]Crash fix : hitting the '0' key during a run while a contruction menu is opened no longer crashes the game.
[*]Fixed all badges and achievements unlocking.
[*]Fixed a case where focus could be regained when removing an upgrader from ship.
[*]Player Profiles can now be consulted from any player contract or sale offer.
[*]Various text corrections.[/list]

Have fun in space,
The Passtech Games Team

notes.title: Watch the Launch Trailer
notes.content:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/24/1466158930-srg-gif-3.gif[/img]

[b]Space Run Galaxy is now available on Steam![/b]

Our previous Gameplay Trailer showed you the ropes of space running, today we let you move on to practice with our Launch Trailer. [b]Strap on your seatbelt, recharge your shields and warm up your reactors, it’s going to be a bumpy intergalactic ride! [/b]

Set 20 years after the original game, Captain Buck Mann has now set up his very own intergalactic courier service. You’re a member of Mann’s team of space runners, racing to deliver precious goods from planet to planet! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2S5s7wAzhjA
Reinforce your modular ships with armaments including laser turrets, missile launchers and energy shields, while leaving enough room for your cargo. Fly fast – the quicker you arrive at your destination, the better the rewards!

In Space Run Galaxy, you must defend your ship and its cargo as it travels the stars to deliver goods to your clients across an entire galaxy. 

With four solar systems and over 50 zones to visit across 100+ runs, Space Run Galaxy offers limitless gameplay, while fresh new features expand the original experience:
[list][*]User-created contracts - Take on contracts from other players for better rewards and unlimited replayability
[*]Intergalactic player market - Trade hard-earned goods with your fellow space runners to sell off extra supplies, or snap up a tidy bargain
[*]New corporations offer riskier jobs - Carry the extra fragile cargo of XenoPrime, or risk transporting The Force's highly dangerous weapon prototypes (which may even endanger your own ship!) 
[*]Fresh dangers await - Face off against brand new boss-type enemies, such as deadly pirate ships and huge space monsters...
[*]Deep customization - Customize the shape, size, and color of any ships you acquire during your adventure. There's no restriction for what ship you use in each mission, letting you get creative with every run![/list]

[b]Space Run Galaxy is now available on Steam for PC.[/b]

Fresh dangers await - Face off against brand new boss-type enemies, such as deadly pirate ships and huge space monsters...

Deep customization - Customize the shape, size, and color of any ships you acquire during your adventure. There's no restriction for what ship you use in each mission, letting you get creative with every run!

notes.title: Pre-order now at 15% off!
notes.content:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/23/1465316124-news-preorder.png[/img]

[b]You can now pre-order Space Run Galaxy for 15% off on Steam![/b] 

Preorder players will also receive exclusive content, including: the original soundtrack (MP3 format), 4 exclusive in-game badges, and access to the Beta starting one week before game's release. 

Defend your ship and cargo as you travel the stars to deliver goods to clients across an entire galaxy, with four planetary systems and over 50 zones to visit. The entire 1st solar system will be at your disposal during the Beta. 

Reinforce your modular ships with armaments including laser turrets, missile launchers and energy shields, while leaving enough room for your cargo. Fly fast - the quicker you arrive at your destination, the better the rewards! 

Space Run Galaxy offers limitless gameplay, with fresh new features expanding the original experience: 
[list]
[*][b]User-created contracts[/b] - Take on contracts from other players for better rewards and unlimited replayability
[*][b]Intergalactic player market[/b] - Trade hard-earned goods with your fellow space runners to sell off extra supplies, or snap up a tidy bargain
[*][b]New corporations offer riskier jobs[/b] - Carry the extra fragile cargo of XenoPrime, or risk transporting The Force's highly dangerous weapon prototypes (which may even endanger your own ship!) 
[*][b]Fresh dangers await[/b] - Face off against brand new boss-type enemies, such as deadly pirate ships and huge space monsters...
[*][b]Deep customization[/b] - Customize the shape, size, and color of any ships you acquire during your adventure. There's no restriction for what ship you use in each mission, letting you get creative with every run!
[/list]

Space Run Galaxy releases on June 17th for PC. For more information, visit the website [b][url=http://www.spacerun-galaxy.com/]here![/url][/b]
